📝 Elections & Voting Rights
NC HB 958 — NC Law Changes: New Rules for Voter Hand-Counts & Early Voting

North Carolina will now require a random hand-to-eye count of paper ballots in every county during presidential elections, and in some cases, for statewide ballot items. Counties must also establish at least one early voting site for every 30,000 registered voters, with sites needing approval from the State Board and offering security measures. ...
